header: One bar and one percentage per row
lead: The number in each row sets the width of its bar. There is no script and no chart library: every bar shows a number an editor typed.
note: Example figures for a museum website relaunch, as at 30 September 2026. For shares of one total, use Distribution Bars; for a single target, use Goal Meter.
